newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mycal's 96/97 profit seen up 33 pct yr/yr--paper.
newsitem.headline: Mycal's 96/97 profit seen up 33 pct yr/yr--paper.

text.p: Japanese supermarket chain operator Mycal Corp's parent current profit in the year to February 28, 1997, is expected to have risen 33 percent year-on-year to about 16 billion yen, a Japanese business daily said on Thursday.
Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the expected rise was due to an increase in sales helped by renovation of some of its outlets and cost-cutting efforts.
Mycal said in August last year that its 1996/97 parent current profit would be 15 billion yen against 12.02 billion yen in 1995/96.
Mycal was not immediately available for comment on the newspaper report.
